title: 第11章铁骨门第12章擂台提前
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
骨灰落地，堆成箭头，指向矿道更深处。
苏意攥着那块石像心脏碎片，沿着箭头方向走。
脚步很轻——梅花拳·夜行步。
前世夜班保安巡逻练出来的轻功，凌晨三点绕着停车场走了两万步，落地无声，踏雪无痕。
矿道里的碎石在脚底碾过，没有发出一丝声响。
箭头尽头是一道暗门。
天然岩缝，只容一人侧身挤过。
门缝里透出微弱的光——不是火光，是骨头的冷光。
苏意侧身挤进去，里面是个很小的石室，三面石壁，一面铁栅栏。
铁栅栏上刻着禁制符文，灵光已经快熄了。
栅栏后面，一个人蜷缩在角落，白发乱得像鸟窝。
赵老蔫。
他身上还穿着那件被牛皋鞭子抽破的矿奴服，背上的血迹早就干了，结成黑褐色的硬痂。
但人还活着，听见脚步声，慢慢抬起头。
眼睛适应了黑暗，看清来人是苏意，嘴唇抖了抖。
“小苏。”
苏意抓住铁栅栏，用力一扯。
禁制符文闪了一下，没拦住。
柳晴布下的禁制靠的是灵力驱动，但苏意体内一丝灵力都没有——禁制感应不到灵力波动，自然触发不了。
铁栅栏被八极拳的暗劲扯断三根，露出一个能钻人的口子。

苏意把赵老蔫拖出来。
老蔫很轻，比十几天前轻了至少二十斤，肩胛骨硌得苏意手掌生疼。
“能走吗？”
“能。”
赵老蔫撑着苏意的肩膀站起来，腿在抖，但站住了。
苏意把石像心脏碎片递给他。
淡金色的光映在赵老蔫脸上，他脸上没有意外，只有沉默。
沉默了很久，久到苏意以为他没力气说话了。
然后赵老蔫挺直了腰。
后背发出一连串骨骼爆响——噼里啪啦，像竹节在火里炸开。
整个人拔高了两寸，佝偻的背打开了，塌下去的肩膀撑平了。
不是变壮了，是骨头在身体里重新排列了一遍。
“瞒不住了。”他说。
苏意看着他的眼睛。
那双浑浊了十几天的眼珠子，此刻清亮得不像老人。
“小苏，老夫不是矿奴。”
赵老蔫靠在石壁上，开始说。
声音不高，但每个字都咬得很清楚。
他叫赵铁骨。
不是外号，是本名。

七年前，青云山脉以西有个宗门叫铁骨门，世代炼体，不修灵力，只炼筋骨。
门中秘典《铁骨锻身大法》修到极致，肉身崩碎后骨不毁、魂不灭，留下的骨头叫“舍利铁骨”。
那截发光的肋骨，就是铁骨大成者死后留下的。
content_en:
The ashes fell to the ground and were piled into arrows, pointing deeper into the mine.
Su Yi clutched the heart fragment of the stone statue and walked in the direction of the arrow.
The steps are very light - Plum Blossom Quan·Night Walk.
I learned Qinggong from night shift security patrol in my previous life. I walked 20,000 steps around the parking lot at three o'clock in the morning. I landed silently and left no trace in the snow.
The gravel in the mine tunnel was crushed under the feet without making a sound.
At the end of the arrow is a secret door.
There is only room for one person to squeeze through the natural rock crevice.
There was a faint light coming from the crack in the door—not the light of fire, but the cold light of bones.
Su Yi squeezed in sideways. Inside was a small stone room with three stone walls and an iron fence.
The iron fence is engraved with forbidden runes, and the aura is almost extinguished.
Behind the fence, a man was huddled in the corner, his white hair as messy as a bird's nest.
Zhao Laowei.
He was still wearing the mining slave uniform that had been torn by Niu Gao's whip. The blood on his back had long since dried and formed dark brown scabs.
But the man was still alive. He heard the footsteps and slowly raised his head.
His eyes adjusted to the darkness, and he saw clearly that the person coming was Su Yi, and his lips trembled.
"Xiao Su."
Su Yi grabbed the iron fence and pulled hard.
The forbidden rune flashed but did not stop him.
The restriction placed by Liu Qing was driven by spiritual power, but there was not a trace of spiritual power in Su Yi's body - the restriction could not sense the fluctuation of spiritual power, so naturally it could not be triggered.
Three of the iron fences were torn apart by the secret power of Bajiquan, revealing a hole that could be used to drill people.
Su Yi dragged Zhao Laowen out.
He was very wilted, at least 20 pounds lighter than a dozen days ago, and his shoulder blades were so bruised that Su Yi's palms hurt.
"Can I leave?"
"Yes."
Zhao Laowen stood up holding Su Yi's shoulders. His legs were shaking, but he stood still.
Su Yi handed him the heart fragment of the stone statue.
The pale golden light reflected on Zhao Laowen's face. There was no surprise on his face, only silence.
There was silence for a long time, so long that Su Yi thought he had no strength to speak.
Then Zhao Laowen straightened his back.
A series of skeletal explosions erupted from the back - crackling, like bamboo joints exploding in fire.
The whole person has grown two inches taller, his rickety back has opened up, and his slumped shoulders have become flat.
It's not that he's getting stronger, it's that his bones have been rearranged in his body.
"I can't hide it anymore," he said.
Su Yi looked into his eyes.
The eyes that had been cloudy for more than ten days were now so clear that they didn't look like an old man.
"Xiao Su, I am not a mine slave."
Zhao Laowen leaned against the stone wall and began to speak.
The voice was not high, but every word was pronounced clearly.
His name is Zhao Tiegu.
It's not a nickname, it's a real name.
Seven years ago, there was a sect to the west of the Qingyun Mountains called the Iron Bone Sect, which had been practicing physical training for generations, not spiritual power, but only muscles and bones.
The secret book "Iron Bone Body Forging Technique" in the sect has been cultivated to the extreme. After the body is broken, the bones are not destroyed and the soul is immortal. The bones left behind are called "Iron Bone Relics".
Those glowing ribs were what the Iron Bone Master left behind after his death.
